data.title: Binghatti Dawn
data.about:
Introducing Binghatti Dawn, an upcoming project by Binghatti Developers located in the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. Binghatti Dawn consists of four floors above the ground with two basement levels for parking. The low-rise development offers premium studios and 1 and 2 bedroom apartments.

Residents can enjoy premium amenities, like a swimming pool, kids' play areas, and a state-of-the-art fitness center. Binghatti Dawn Residences offers a refined living experience in one of Dubai's most coveted areas. Its prime location ensures Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connectivity, providing residents with easy access to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

characteristics_module.title: Not Just a Residence But a Work of Art
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Strategically located in Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a blend of modern luxury and sophisticated design.
  • Premium studios and 1 & 2-bedroom apartments are designed with meticulous attention to detail and bespoke finishes.
  • Iconic architecture inspired by dawn symbolizes a fresh start and limitless possibilities.
  • Unparalleled connectivity with easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, and key destinations like Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.
  • Luxurious Binghatti Dawn facilities include expansive swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centers, and dedicated kids' play areas.
  • Avant-garde design featuring warm luxury interiors crafted with high-end materials and seamless transitions.
  • Flexible payment plans make it an ideal Binghatti Dawn real estate investment opportunity for discerning buyers seeking a prestigious lifestyle.
  • Strategically located near top shopping malls and world-class dining venues, enhancing the premium living experience.

location_tile.title: Binghatti Dawn: A Prime Investment Opportunity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Dawn is perfectly situated in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, providing residents with easy access to key destinations across the city. JVC exemplifies the remarkable growth of Dubai's real estate sector, showcasing a rapidly evolving landscape that keeps pace with the city's expansion. Its strategic location and innovative urban design make JVC an attractive investment hub, offering lucrative opportunities and sustainable development for investors.

  • Dubai Hills Mall - 06 Minutes
  • Business Bay - 20 Minutes
  • Burj Khalifa - 17 Minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 24 Minutes
